notes.title: Christmas Special (v3.1)
notes.content:
We're back with a new holiday special patch. 

It's finally time to reveal the hooded figure. Fight your way through and face him in an epic battle. His secrets are waiting!

- A new level location where you fight the hooded figure.
- A new journey containing 12 levels, where you will meet new enemies.
- Special Christmas levels that are only available during December.

Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Halloween Special (v3.05)
notes.content:
We have a new holiday patch ready where Evil Killer Clowns are waiting to bring you down!

These are some of the things that are added in the new patch:

- 3 new level locations, Second Hangar, Burial Ground and Clown Forest.
- A new hero, Mechwarrior. Equipped with powerful skills and weapons.
- 3 Endless Levels, The Lab, The Highway Village and The Graveyard.
- Voices for all the heroes. It'll bring out more life from your favourite heroes.
- Bug fixes and ingame patch notes.

Enjoy and have a nice holiday!

notes.title: Version 1.62
notes.content:
By popular demand, we've reworked and changed the controls! You should feel right at home and familiar with the latest controls if you have played other RTS type of games before. If you have some requests, don't be shy to contact us!

We're continuing to make more levels and more items. We're in the making of doing "long play" levels. Those will be unlocked after the Lab.

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Released for real!
notes.content:
The game is finally released for real and has moved away from Early Access. We’re really glad and thankful for all the help we’ve gotten from the community! We hope you all have had a great time with the game and not been bothered too much with all the bugs and early features. 

Early Access has been a great experience for us, and we believe the game is in a much better shape now than it was before we released it on Steam.

Thanks for all the help & 
Welcome all new players!

notes.title: New Version 1.42
notes.content:
The new version is live and kicking! For this patch we added two more story missions as a weekend special bonus for you all. 

What can you expect coming out from the sewers? There will be something waiting for you, expect a whole new game mode. We really hope you'll like it!

A handful of achievements are also added for you to collect! Two of them are reserved for the end levels, just so you know.

Read up on the 1.4 patch here:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/434020/announcements/detail/660146771866343093

Have a great weekend!

notes.title: Leaving Early Access
notes.content:
We are preparing the game to leave early access and enter the scary real store front. Having that said we're going to raise the price of the game the upcoming week. 

We're not dropping the game or the support when it goes live, we plan to continue patching the game.

We want to thank all of you who is being involved in the process! We have gotten really good support by the community, without all of you the game would be in a much worse state than what it is now!

Thanks for all the love!

(We estimate the real version to go live late March, early April. We have a lot of work ahead of us, more levels, achievements and more!)

notes.title: Beta Version 1.4
notes.content:
We released a new beta version including some new things:

- A new Hero, The Soldier
He uses an assault rifle that can be equipped with a grenade launcher and a flamethrower at the same time which is great for stopping Zombies.
His skills are:
* Roadblock, to block lanes for a while.
* Instant Recover, when he almost dies he recovers to full health.
* Field Medic, he can heal others but not himself.

- A new Turret, the Tesla turret. It shoots electrical charges which bounce from zombie to zombie. The last one in the chain will receive the most damage! 

- A couple of new story missions with new types of enemies

Improved controls: 
- Use the right mouse button to cancel actions
- Pan the camera by moving to the edge of the screen, like in RTS games. (Starcraft) *Still work in progress*

- Bug fixes, things reported on the discussion board and some issues we found ourselves

Please try it out and tell us what you think. :)

notes.title: The Journey of Last Hope
notes.content:
So far we're getting great feedback from the community and we're working full time, every day to make the game as good as it could be. We've fixed most of the reported bugs and since the first release, we've improved the balance of the game, controls and graphics. We're are not quite there yet but if you're into strategy games you would probably like this game...

And hopefully you would want to be a part of the development, play it and share your experience with us. Along the way we can improve the game together!

If you enter the discussion boards, you can get info on how to download the latest beta version which we'll release as often as possible, with new cool content and features!

notes.title: New Release V.1.1
notes.content:
We've just uploaded a new version, ready for the weekend. 

We've fixed tons of bugs reported by the great community. As well as balancing a few of the turrets.

- A new turret has been introduced, a Sniper Turret. Deals a great amount of damage!
- New levels with new villains, meet the raiders. Raiders with shields, suicide bombers, medics and more!

Good luck surviving the wasteland!
